Predicted power is 57.6 µW.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "itail":   (22e-6, 10e-6, 26e-6),
    "c2":      (0.4e-12, 0.2e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "r_ratio": (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),
    "c3x":     (1.0e-12, 0.3e-12, 4e-12),
    "kf":      (1.0, 0.9, 1.1),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    fc_t = 1.5e6
    w0 = 2 * PI * fc_t * p["kf"]       # Butterworth 3rd order: real pole at wc, biquad wc with Q=1
    Q = 1.0

    # ---------------- OTA (5T, NMOS diff pair) ----------------
    itail = p["itail"]
    Lb = 1.0
    gmid_b = 12.0
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mtail = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, itail, vds=0.3)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], itail / 2, vds=0.55, vsb=0.3)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], 0.5, itail / 2, vds=1.0)
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A0 = gm1 / (m1.gds + mp.gds)
    Ab = A0 / (1 + A0)
    zout = 1.0 / gm1

    # ---------------- Sallen-Key biquad ----------------
    r = p["r_ratio"]
    nC = Q**2 * (1 + r)**2 / r
    C2 = p["c2"]
    C1 = nC * C2
    R2 = 1.0 / (w0 * C2 * math.sqrt(r * nC))
    R1 = r * R2
    C2phys = max(C2 - m1.cgd - 0.3 * m1.cgg, 0.05e-12)

    # ---------------- output RC pole (absorbs CL) ----------------
    C3tot = cl + p["c3x"]
    Rtot = 1.0 / (w0 * C3tot)
    R3 = max(Rtot - zout, 1e3)
    C3 = p["c3x"]

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtail)
    # diff pair: M1 noninverting (gate n2), M2 inverting (gate tied to ob -> follower)
    n.dev("M1", "dmir", "n2", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "ob", "ob", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "dmir", "dmir", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "ob", "dmir", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R1)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "n2", R2)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "ob", C1)
    n.C("C2", "n2", "vss", C2phys)
    n.R("R3", "ob", "vout", R3)
    n.C("C3", "vout", "vss", C3)

    # ---------------- prediction ----------------
    f = np.logspace(1, 8, 4000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Hsk = Ab / (s**2 * R1 * R2 * C1 * C2 + s * C2 * (R1 + R2) + s * R1 * C1 * (1 - Ab) + 1)
    Hrc = 1.0 / (1 + s * (R3 + zout) * C3tot)
    ftr = zout / (R1 + 1.0 / (s * C1) + zout)
    H = (Hsk + ftr) * Hrc
    mag = 20 * np.log10(np.abs(H))
    g0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < g0 - 3.0)[0]
    fc = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else 1e8
    fs = 10 * fc
    ss = 2j * PI * fs
    Hs = (Ab / (ss**2*R1*R2*C1*C2 + ss*(C2*(R1+R2) + R1*C1*(1-Ab)) + 1)
          + zout / (R1 + 1/(ss*C1) + zout)) / (1 + ss*(R3+zout)*C3tot)
    atten = g0 - 20 * math.log10(abs(Hs))
    peaking = max(float(np.max(mag) - g0), 0.0)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)

    return n, {"gain_db": float(g0), "fc": fc, "atten_db": float(atten),
               "peaking_db": peaking, "power": power}
```
